name: v4
description: Everything that has held up so far, combined: entries with the H1 trend, the bot's votes on H1 or H1 + M15, the owner's RSI-extreme entry block and RSI force-close, stop and target in H1 volatility units with an optional dollar cap, at most one MACD-turn ladder add, and a pause after a losing basket. Searched on Jan 2023 - Nov 2026; 2021-2022 is kept for one final test.

open_weights.note: which timeframes' votes open a basket (live: H1 + M15; V3-lite: H1)

entry_agree_s.note: 2 = both M15 votes must agree with the entry (live); 0 = no agreement needed

vol_cap_usd_per_unit.note: most one volatility unit may be worth, USD per 0.01 lot; 0 = no cap

max_adds.note: one equal-sized add released by an M5 MACD turn, at least 1 unit from the entry

loss_cooldown_s.note: pause after a losing basket, seconds

entry_rsi_block_tfs.note: the owner's rule: no new basket while the H1 or H4 RSI is beyond 35 / 65

fc_rsi_tfs.note: the owner's rule: force-close when the H1 and H4 RSI are both beyond the level against the basket (needs the force-close on)

force_close_enabled.note: the live M15 slope force-close (and with it the RSI force-close)
